title: 多文化お茶会｜立命館大学 社会知能研究室

summary.lead: A cherry blossom viewing was held at the Expo Commemorative Park!

overview: We went to see the cherry blossoms at Expo'70 Commemorative Park. It's one of the projects we've wanted to do someday, and we're glad that we were able to hold it under sunny skies. On that day, the cherry blossoms were in full bloom, and we had a sweets party (drinking party?) in the midst of the very beautiful cherry blossoms. Everyone is confused about the new semester and unfamiliar campus life, though, everyone felt refreshed by the cherry blossom viewing this time, and the friendship was deepened, and we all felt motivated to do our best in our new lives. It was a very fun meeting, with everyone chatting about their memories of spring break.
